property_summary: For any sender and any nonzero ETH amount sent to C via its receive(), the reference contract always accepts the payment (call succeeds) and increments depositsCount by 1 (so a send succeeds and depositsCount increases), whereas the mutant that unconditionally reverts will cause the receive call to fail (revert) for some inputs, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Make the require condition deliberately false to force every receive() to revert and thus prevent depositsCount from increasing.
